mapping_contract.R: X requires Y as an actual prerequisite in declared event context, not mere permission or correlation.
mapping_contract.P: X prevents occurrence of Y in declared context, not symmetric incompatibility or hindrance.
mapping_contract.support: Provisional plausible labels are hypotheses about grammatical frame feasibility, not verified realized examples. Unresolved labels need explicit context/scope or rewrite. Zero verified labels because no independent review or frozen complete templates. Full candidates may still merge or fail validator. No corpus text, no synthetic sample hash.

power_rules: No fractional independent family count via mean factorial support / 8. Full blocks only for v5 four-pair statistic. Partial blocks separate descriptive stratum, no pooling or imputation; a new partial-block estimator needs prospective amendment. Final power unresolved until independent F and split. Probability of positive family sign .8 is planning assumption, not measured, and observed post hoc power is not evidence; report effect, CI, sensitivity to true p and ties. If only full candidates survive, illustrative pool 8 before possible merges, with 3 EVAL under prior assignments; no meaningful confirmatory test at first Holm threshold .05/3 even with all 3 signs positive (p=.125).

report_additions.small_change: Report |d|<0.01 fraction (including numerical ties), magnitude quantiles and distribution by axis and context, score units separately. 1e-12 is numerical tie tolerance, not practical effect threshold.
report_additions.reversed_pattern: Before interpreting reversed direction, verify class 0/1 orientation and labels, swap order/gold pair IDs, compare exact feature parity against pinned executor and score sign convention; inspect weights only after those checks, no automatic sign flip.
report_additions.v51: User describes v5.1 operational definitions; actual v5.1 file not verified in this pass. Do not silently overwrite its tie or inference rules. These report additions do not change gates.
